resources.string: Independent application, not affiliated with Proton.
Create simple events in your calendar app, without reminders, guests, recurrence or custom colors. Editing and deletion have separate options.
For personal events without guests or repeats. Existing reminders and event colors are preserved. Enable the corresponding options to change other fields.
Creations waiting or requiring attention: %1$d. An uncertain send is never repeated automatically.
Synchronization with Android encountered a problem. Your data is retained.

Edit descriptions and locations, including an accompanying title change. For combined date changes, also enable the date option and any other affected option. Existing reminders and colors are preserved; changes to them stay local.
Read-only by default. Creation, title, text, dates and deletion have separate options. Enable the affected options for combined edits. Unsupported changes and pending work are retained.

Change dates, duration, time zone or switch between timed and all-day events. Enable the affected options when changing title or text too. Existing reminders and colors are preserved. Guests and recurrence remain unsupported.
Simple imported events only, without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Other deletions stay on Android.
Android may delay background synchronization to save battery. Both automatic synchronization settings must be enabled.

Android can delay synchronization to save battery. You can optionally exclude Calendeer from battery optimization. This may use more battery. Continue to review the Android dialog, or keep the current setting.
Automatic synchronization is off. Selected calendars will wait until you tap Synchronize or turn automatic synchronization back on in Android settings.
The account is not ready yet. Check your account connection and calendar access, then try again.
Unable to request synchronization. Try again.
